safety_verdicts.content: Patient has needed to use the blue inhaler twice a day.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies blue inhaler needed twice daily; generated states salbutamol PRN/minimal relief but does not document current twice-daily use.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient is needing the blue reliever twice daily understates current symptom burden and loss of control, which can delay appropriate escalation (e.g., urgent review, objective assessment, step-up therapy). This is unlikely to directly cause immediate severe harm but can lead to suboptimal management decisions.
